description: Every scheduled state minimum wage change from a date (default today) through 2027-12-31, sorted by date, with the new rate, the previous rate, the change and the tipped cash wage. Includes 2027-01-01 increases already enacted in law or announced under inflation indexing, and lists indexed changes whose number is not published yet as announced:false. Optional filter by states.

from.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD (exclusive). Defaults to today.

states.description: Optional list of states to include.

items.description: US state name or 2-letter code, or DC. Examples: "California", "TX", "District of Columbia".

name: list_upcoming_increases
title: List upcoming minimum wage increases
